_comment: Theorems checked in frontend/test_leech_theta.ml (the theta series of the Leech lattice, a weight-12 modular form). Each count is the EXACT number of lattice points at that norm, proven as an integer (no error bar). Not invented; re-derived in Yon's oracle every build.

shells.label: kissing
shells.note: the kissing number: nearest neighbours. In 3 dimensions this is 12.
